intro: Matrix Copper RO Water Purifier is a countertop water purification system designed for brackish water. It features an 80 GPD RO membrane with RO + UF + UV + Copper Alkaline purification to deliver safe, clean, and great-tasting drinking water. With a 10-litre storage tank and purification capacity of up to 12 litres per hour, it is ideal for domestic use.
features: RO + UF + UV + Copper Alkaline multi-stage purification.
80 GPD Thin Film Composite (TFC) membrane for effective purification.
Suitable for brackish water with TDS up to 3000 ppm.
12 LPH purification capacity with 10-litre storage tank.
Copper Alkaline technology enhances water with essential minerals.
UV protection helps ensure microbiologically safe water.
Energy-efficient operation with only 50W power consumption.
Wide voltage compatibility (100–300V AC) for stable performance.
High-quality Merlin pump and components for reliable operation.
Suitable for brackish water with TDS up to 3000 ppm .
